scope: Local deterministic regression qualification; not an independent hardware claim.

qualification.name: startup
qualification.detail: Only the launcher/editor shell is required initially; task workspaces remain independently addressable.

qualification.name: hierarchy-10000
qualification.detail: Map-backed parent lookup verifies the same O(n) index used by Hierarchy search and ancestor expansion.

qualification.name: assets-50000
qualification.detail: Search uses a normalized haystack and retains only the bounded virtual viewport window.

qualification.name: graphs-1000
qualification.detail: A 1,000-node graph index resolves links without scanning the document per edge.

qualification.name: memory
qualification.detail: Interactive histories are bounded and exported captures remain explicit user actions.

qualification.name: low-end
qualification.detail: The low-end profile limits pixel density and expensive effects while preserving project data and authoring tools.
